sql: select count(*) as "count" from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and exists (select "lead_notes"."id" from "lead_notes" where "lead_notes"."lead_id" = "leads"."id" and normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce(note, '')), NFD), $1, '', 'g'), NFC) like normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce($2, '')), NFD), $3, '', 'g'), NFC))

select * from "leads" where "deleted_at" is null and "account_id" in (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "deleted_at" is null) and exists (select "id" from "crm_accounts" where "crm_accounts"."id" = "leads"."account_id" and "archived_at" is null) and exists (select "lead_notes"."id" from "lead_notes" where "lead_notes"."lead_id" = "leads"."id" and normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce(note, '')), NFD), $1, '', 'g'), NFC) like normalize(regexp_replace(normalize(lower(coalesce($2, '')), NFD), $3, '', 'g'), NFC)) order by "fecha_creacion" desc, "id" desc limit $4 offset $5
